cs.t: 3-4 years ago maybe?  DC 33 I think is what I had.  The little hose that connected to the bottom near the spinning brush wouldn't stay connected... I had to put duct tape on it...  And one of the wheels came out of it's little "axel" and wouldn't stay in... had to super glue that.  The canister button broke... had to use like a paper-clip to wiggle that open. And what I think was a major design flaw... When I turned it on, it took like 30 seconds to actually get any suction... when I contacted support on that they said it had to build up pressure.  So I would turn the vacuum on, let it sit for a minute before I could use it.  Total joke.  I wasted time taking it to a repair shop that offered to replace the motor... for basically the cost of a new one.  Dyson wouldn't cover it. Anyway they don't make that model any more... and if you're happy with what you got, I'm happy for you.  I wasn't happy with what I got and Dyson made me take it back to Costco instead of offering to stand behind their product.  I want to say it was something like $400... seems like for that price they should stand behind it.  https://www.amazon.com/Dyson-DC33-Multi-Floor-Upright-Bagles...
